HowItWorks.title: From a verified wallet to a payout
HowItWorks.lead: Four steps, and each one leaves a record on Solana.
HowItWorks.verifyBody: Pass a one-time identity check (KYC). Your wallet is then added to the on-chain list of approved investors.
HowItWorks.buyBody: Choose a car and buy whole shares at its listed price. The shares arrive in your wallet as that car's token.
HowItWorks.earnBody: The car works as a taxi in Almaty. Each period the operator deposits its net income, after expenses and a maintenance reserve, into the car's vault on Solana.
HowItWorks.claimBody: Your part of each deposit is your shares divided by all shares sold. Claim it from your portfolio; each period can be claimed once.
HowItWorks.photoAlt: A taxi on an Almaty street at golden hour, with the mountains behind it
HowItWorks.photoCaption: A taxi in Almaty. Photo: Alina Makhatyrova, Unsplash.

Verify.title: Rules in code, records in public
Verify.lead: You don't have to take our word for the numbers. The program enforces these rules, and every account listed here opens in Solana Explorer.
Verify.tokenBody: Each car is its own Token-2022 mint, with the make, model and year written into the token's metadata.
Verify.holdersBody: Only approved wallets can buy shares or receive them in a transfer. The token checks this on every transfer, whichever app sends it.
Verify.payoutsBody: Income sits in a vault that only the program can pay out from. It works out each holder's part from their shares and rejects a second claim for the same period.
Verify.codeBody: The programs, the backend and this app are public under the MIT license.
Verify.ledgerLead: Addresses read from the chain when this page loaded.
Verify.ledgerError: Couldn't read the car accounts from Solana. Try again from the stats above.

Disclosure.devnetBody: AXEL runs on Solana devnet, a test network. The cars listed here are test projects, prices are in devnet SOL, which has no market value, and nothing on this site is an offer to invest.
Disclosure.risksTitle: What can go wrong with a real car
Disclosure.riskIncome: Income depends on the car. It falls when the car is off the road for repairs, after an accident or when demand drops.
Disclosure.riskReport: Payouts are not guaranteed. The operator reports and deposits the income, and the program does not yet check that amount against trip data.
Disclosure.riskExit: There is no market for shares yet, so you may not be able to sell early.
Disclosure.riskValue: A car loses value as it ages.
